summary: Ellomay Capital Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K reporting that on October 6, 2026, the first 30 MW portion of its 87 MW Ellomay Solar Italy Five facility in Lazio, Italy, was connected to the Italian national grid and began producing power. The remaining 57 MW is expected to connect in the coming weeks. Ellomay Solar Italy Five S.r.l. is 51% owned by Ellomay; expected P50 annual output for the full 87 MW is roughly 160 GWh. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation mechanics are stated; this is an operational milestone, not a deal. Watch remaining grid connection and power-price exposure.
